title: Lapin extension manifest
description: One extension of the Lapin Extensions catalogue: extensions/<id>/manifest.json. tools/lib.mjs checks the same rules, and a few this schema cannot say (an SPDX expression's grammar, a range of versions, a content pack asking for no permission).

id.description: Its folder's name: lowercase, dots and dashes, a reversed domain or your GitHub name first (ro.ciuntucbimstudio.mobilier-living, octocat.brick-hatches).

screenshots.description: Pictures for store.lapinbim.com: files in the extension's folder (screenshot.webp, screenshot-2.png…) or https addresses.

version.description: Semantic versioning; raised with every change.

github.description: The GitHub account that may change it.

forum.description: The author's user name on forum.lapinbim.com (set by store.lapinbim.com for what is submitted there; the store's author page).

license.description: An SPDX licence expression (MIT, CC-BY-4.0, CC0-1.0, Apache-2.0 OR MIT): required, shown to the user before installing. Any is accepted; permissive ones are marked so, others "read its terms", non-commercial ones (CC-BY-NC-*, PolyForm-Noncommercial-1.0.0…) "Non-commercial".

lapin.description: The Lapin versions it works with: >=0.1.860, >=0.1.860 <0.3.0, ^0.1.900, *.

permissions.description: What a script asks for; a content pack asks for none.

requires.description: Lapin modules it needs beyond its kind's (a script: scripting).

file.description: The package file's name (.lapinlib furniture, .lapin template, .lapintypes types, .lapinprofiles profiles, .pat hatches, .json title block, .lapinprices price list, .lapinsymbols symbols, .lin line types, .lapinstandards drafting standards, .lapinrules rule packs, .lapinbarshapes bar shapes, .lapinparams shared parameters, .lapinmapping mappings, .lapinfamily families, .py script).

items.description: What it holds, shown before installing.

url.description: The file in a GitHub release of the author's.

mirror.description: Set by the index build: lapinbim.com's copy.

download.description: Set by the index build: the store's counting address (store.lapinbim.com/api/download/<id>/<version>), which redirects to lapinbim.com's copy.

signature.description:
Set when the index is signed: the store key's Ed25519 signature of 'lapin-extension-package
1
<id>
<version>
<sha256>
<size>
'.

indicative.description: A price list's prices and a rule pack's values (and norms) are the author's and indicative: true for every price list and rule pack.

purchase.description: A paid extension (stage 2a, lapin-pro docs/plan-extensions.md §12): sold by its author through their own shop; the store gives the package to a licence key the provider says is valid. Its package.url is then https://store.lapinbim.com/api/licensed/<id>/<version> and it has no mirror or download (tools/lib.mjs checks that).

provider.description: The author's shop, whose public licence API the store asks.

productId.description: The product's id at its provider (Gumroad: product_id, from the product's Content tab).

checkoutUrl.description: Where it is bought (the Buy button).

terms.description: The seller's terms of sale and refunds.

price.description: Shown only, as indicative (29 EUR); the price is the seller's.
